title: Provider vocabulary
intro: The labels of the vehicle-data provider's codes, per language. They are fetched by «Test connection» — and here, by hand.
refreshed: The vocabulary was fetched again in all four languages.
refreshFailed: The vocabulary could not be fetched again.
partial: The provider did not answer. Already fetched: {{languages}}.
empty: No vocabulary fetched yet. «Test connection» in the administration fetches it, or «Refresh vocabulary» here.
loadError: The vocabulary could not be loaded.
